---
title: "Methods - Stardist model assessment"
output: null
---

Analysis of Stardist model accuracy using manual corrections of segmentation
results from control samples in the Shrb and Pnut RNAi experiments.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Methods/segmentation validation: load manually corrected Stardist count data.

groundtruth_2ch_file <- "../Data/Methods_Stardist_DAPI_Fas3_groundtruth_counts.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Methods_Stardist_model_assessment.pdf"

groundtruth_2ch <- read_analysis_csv(groundtruth_2ch_file)
```

```{r}
# Methods/segmentation validation: calculate precision and recall from true
# positives, false positives, and false negatives.

calculate_stardist_metrics <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      TruePositive = ModelTL - FalsePos,
      precision = TruePositive / ModelTL,
      recall = TruePositive / (TruePositive + FalseNeg)
    )
}

groundtruth_2ch <- calculate_stardist_metrics(groundtruth_2ch)
```

```{r}
# Methods/segmentation validation: reshape precision and recall for plotting and
# summaries.

groundtruth_long <- groundtruth_2ch %>%
  select(Filename, precision, recall) %>%
  pivot_longer(!Filename, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("precision", "recall")))
```

```{r}
# Methods/segmentation validation: plot precision and recall for the model used
# for follicle cell counts.

groundtruth_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey", linewidth = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Segmentation accuracy")

ggsave(output_file, width = 50, height = 20, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Methods/segmentation validation: summary values for precision and recall.

summarize_mean_sd(
  groundtruth_long,
  group_cols = "Metric",
  value_col = Value
)
```
